faq.title: Frequently asked *questions*
faq.lead: Answers to what farmers and grain elevators ask us most.

items.a: Wood chips, firewood, sawdust and shavings, corn cobs, sunflower husks and other agricultural and wood waste. The fuel needs no sorting or preparation, and its moisture can reach 45% or more.

items.q: Is drying grain safe from fire?
items.a: Yes. The generator has a heat exchanger and a temperature stabilisation system that stops sparks from reaching the dryer, so the grain does not ignite. Drying temperature is adjustable from 30 to 120 (140) °C within ±1 °C.
We adapt the furnace and heat exchanger to any type of drying chamber without damaging the existing equipment. Installations run on dryers including Comil, GSI and Sukup.

items.q: How much attention does the furnace need?
items.a: Fuel is fed manually or automatically, with loading every 6–12 hours. After the season the furnace needs no extra maintenance, just a few hours of work. The heat exchanger and furnace can be cleaned while running.

items.q: How much electricity does it use?
items.a: A 1–6 MW furnace uses 3 to 15 kWh of electricity.

items.q: How do I work out savings and boiler payback?
items.a: Use the calculator: enter crop, moisture, tonnage and fuel prices, and optionally the boiler price. The result is an estimate; our manager will prepare an exact quote.

items.q: How fast will I get a quote?
items.a: We reply within one business day.

how.title: From fuel to *hot air*
how.hint: Click a stage to see the details

steps.x: Wood chips, firewood, agricultural waste or corn cobs go into the hopper and are fed to the furnace by a screw. The fuel needs no sorting or drying and its moisture can reach 45% or more. Loading is manual or automatic, every 6–12 hours.
The gasifier principle burns the raw material almost completely. A high-temperature ceramic lining protects the steel parts from overheating, and once running the furnace burns without smoke.
Flue gas passes through a heat exchanger cooled by a fan. The heated air never mixes with the flue gas, and temperature stabilisation holds ±1 °C within 30–120 (140) °C.
Clean hot air flows through ducts to the dryer. A cyclone dust collector and spark arrestor stop sparks, so the grain does not ignite. A control cabinet with an alarm unit runs the whole system.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we process the data you send through the contact forms on this site.

p: The data controller is Strasslider sp. z o.o., Sielecka 7, 37-700 Przemyśl, Poland, e-mail: sales@strasslider.com, tel. +48 601 073 119.

When you send a contact form or the quick request we receive: your name, phone or e-mail, your message, the selected model or topic, the calculator summary (if you attach it), the site language and the page the request was sent from.
Calculator results are computed in your browser and are not sent to us until you click “Get a quote”.
We process the data to answer your enquiry and prepare a quote (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and for our legitimate interest in running our business and defending claims (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Your enquiry reaches our sales team by e-mail and is also kept in a backup log on our server. We keep the data for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and, where necessary, until claims expire. We do not sell data or pass it to third parties for marketing.

We only use the functional cookie “gd_lang”, which remembers the language you chose (up to 12 months). We use no analytics or advertising cookies and load no external tracking scripts. Fonts and media are served from our own server.

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object to the processing of your data. To use these rights write to sales@strasslider.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your data protection supervisory authority.
